name: crisp
description: Clear, to-the-point answers. Answer first, max 20 words per sentence, one idea per sentence, plain words. Rules adapted from ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.

interface.shortDescription: Clear, to-the-point answers with ASD-STE100 rules.
interface.longDescription: Loads Crisp writing rules at the start of each session. Every answer leads with the answer, uses sentences of 20 words or fewer, and uses plain words. Also rewrites hard-to-read text, gives a TL;DR, and scores text for readability.
defaultPrompt: Explain this code in Crisp style.
Clarify this text so it is easy to understand.
Check this README for readability problems.
